description: Compute the conjugate of a complex number given in algebraic form. Multiple-choice exercise.

source.description: Cambodian BAC II grade-12 math textbook, Chapter 1 (complex numbers, algebraic form) — exercises only
source.extracted_by: manual OCR/transcription from scanned textbook (Claude Code), 2026-08-25

exercises.prompt_latex: \text{Given the complex number } z = -3+2i. \text{ The conjugate of } z \text{ is: (a) } \bar z = 3-2i \quad \text{(b) } \bar z = -3-2i \quad \text{(c) } \bar z = 3+2i \quad \text{(d) } \bar z = -2+3i \quad \text{(e) another answer}
exercises.technique: Definition of conjugate: for z=a+bi, \bar z = a-bi.
